## 🧪 Data Table Extraction Tester
(powered by easybits)

Upload a PDF or image, run it through the easybits Extractor, and get an instant pass/fail report that checks every extracted cell against a reference you define, plus how long the extraction took. Built to prove out table extraction and compare the two engines before you trust a pipeline in production.

## ⚙️ How it works

1. Upload a document on the form and pick which engine you used (General or Specialized) so it gets logged.
2. A timer starts, then the easybits Extractor pulls the table into structured rows.
3. A Code node flattens those rows and records how long the extraction took.
4. A second Code node compares every cell against your reference data, scores the accuracy, and lists any mismatches.
5. The run is logged to a Google Sheet and shown as a styled pass/fail card on the form completion screen.

## 🚀 Set up steps

1. In the easybits platform, create a pipeline for your document and build the response structure: a single "records" field set as an array of type object, with each column nested inside it. The full walkthrough is in the setup guide in this repo.
2. In the Extractor node, select your pipeline and point the binary input at the form's file field.
3. Open "Code: Validate & Score" and replace the EXPECTED array with your own known-good values, one object per row. Set any field you cannot verify to null and it will be skipped.
4. Optional: add Google Sheets credentials and a sheet with these log columns: run_at, engine_label, pass, accuracy_pct, extraction_seconds, mismatch_count. Use RAW value input on the Append node.
5. The "Extraction Engine" dropdown is only a label for the log. Set the actual model inside the pipeline in the easybits platform, then pick the matching label when you run.
6. Run the form, read the pass/fail card, and use the mismatches list to refine your field descriptions until you hit 100 percent.
